benefits.heading: Modern Procedures/Treatments
benefits.text:
If in the future, you need to undergo a treatment which requires the use of advanced technologies or robotic surgeries, you need not worry about the medical expenses.
The Activ One MAX+ Health Insurance Plan provides coverage for listed modern treatment methods like Robotic surgeries, Oral chemotherapy, Stem cell therapy and more as a part of In-patient hospitalization or Daycare treatments.

benefits.heading: In-Patient Hospitalization Treatment
benefits.text: In case of a planned treatment or an unforeseen emergency which leads to hospitalization for more than 24 hours, this plan will cover expenses like room rent, doctor’s fees, operation theater expenses, medicines, drugs and other consumables as actuals up to Base Sum Insured.

benefits.heading: Pre and Post Hospitalization Medical Expenses
benefits.text: Expenses for consultations, medicines or diagnostic tests before or after hospitalization will be covered for up to 90 days before hospitalization and up to 180 days after discharge from the hospital, once the hospitalization claim is accepted by us.
benefits.evidence:

benefits.heading: Day Care Treatment
benefits.text: Due to advancements in medical science, certain medical procedures like dialysis, may not require a 24-hour hospitalization. All such Day Care procedures will also be covered under this plan.
